title: CityCatalyst webhook envelope (v1)
description: JSON body POSTed to every webhook subscriber. The raw body bytes are what the X-CityCatalyst-Signature header signs. Consumers MUST ignore unknown fields.

id.description: Delivery id. Equals the X-CityCatalyst-Delivery header. Use as the idempotency key (delivery is at-least-once).

type.description: Event type. The type string is the contract identity; a breaking change ships as a new type (e.g. inventory.published.v2).

created_at.description: When the event was emitted (ISO 8601, UTC).

data.description: Event-specific payload. Small ids and scalars only. Always includes organizationId.
